issue_context.title: `RenderDevice::poll()` drops the return value for `wgpu::Device::poll()`
issue_context.body:
## Bevy version

0.10.1

## What you did

Attempted to use `RenderDevice::poll()` to check whether my compute shader had finished running.

## What went wrong

`RenderDevice::poll()` has no return value, and thus doesn't inform me whether it's finished. Which is surprising, as it's just a passthrough on `wgpu::Device::poll()`, which DOES have a return value.

## Additional information

Per the docs for [`wgpu::Device::poll()`](https://docs.rs/wgpu/latest/wgpu/struct.Device.html#method.poll), it both checks for work to do, and then returns a boolean telling you if there is no work remaining. The `RenderDevice::poll()` function drops that return value.

It's trivial to work around this by calling `RenderDevice::wgpu_device().poll()`, which is what I'm doing for now. But that shouldn't be necessary.

review_comments: Can you describe what the return value means here?
Sure thing! Added the description about the return value from the wgpu docs.
